entities.summary: Carlos "Carlitos" Miguel Páez Rodríguez is a Uruguayan entrepreneur and former rugby player. He is one of the 16 survivors of the Uruguayan Air Force Flight 571, which crashed in the Andes mountains on 13 October 1972. He is the son of the painter Carlos Páez Vilaró.

entities.summary: Carlos "Carlitos" Miguel Páez Rodríguez is a Uruguayan entrepreneur and former rugby player. He is one of the 16 survivors of the Uruguayan Air Force Flight 571, which crashed in the Andes mountains on 13 October 1972. He is the son of the painter Carlos Páez Vilaró.
